s.note: Baby Groot dancing while the others fight the monster
s.how: Cut 800g sweet potatoes into thin sticks and toss with a little oil, smoked paprika and salt. Spread in a single layer on lined trays without crowding. Bake at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once, until crisp at the edges. Pile into a little pot.

Cook 300g arborio rice with stock and a pinch of saffron into a risotto, stir in parmesan and chill overnight. Roll into balls around small cubes of mozzarella. Coat in beaten egg and panko and fry at 180C until perfectly golden all over.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add 2 sliced onions, 2 carrots and a spoon of smoked paprika. Pour in 375ml stout and enough water to cover. Simmer for 3 hours until thick and tender. Serve in big bowls with crusty bread.

w.note: the Ravager ships lighting up the sky for Yondu
w.how: Heat 150ml cream until steaming and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring until smooth. Scoop vanilla ice cream into bowls and pour over the warm sauce. Scatter popping candy on top at the table so it crackles like fireworks.

d.n: Ego's garden pear and passionfruit cooler
d.note: Ego's planet looks like a giant garden
d.how: In a jug, mix 800ml pear nectar with the pulp of 4 passionfruit and the juice of 1 lime. Bruise a handful of mint leaves and stir them through, then chill for 30 minutes. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice, pour in the nectar until three quarters full and top with sparkling water. Garnish with mint sprigs and a thin pear slice.
